locationComparison.name: Abyssal Area
notes: Not efficient due to aggressive abyssal creatures and distant spawns, except for Konar tasks.
Ensouled heads dropped here can be reanimated for slightly faster task progression.

locationComparison.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Multi-combat area allows barraging in the primary rooms and more AFK play in both primary and secondary rooms.
Catacombs kills can drop Dark totem pieces; Greater abyssal demons in the Catacombs always drop a Dark totem piece.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower
notes: Very far to reach without 71 Agility; use the basement for Slayer tasks when possible.
Morytania Diary completion grants bonus Slayer experience in the Slayer Tower.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower Basement
notes: Task only. Safespot requires the Teleport anchoring scroll permanent unlock.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Only Abyssal demon location where a cannon can be used.
Includes blighted item drops and Last Man Standing reward-shop drops.

taskNotes: Abyssal demons use accurate melee stab attacks with a max hit of 8; Protect from Melee neutralizes normal Abyssal demon damage.
Greater abyssal demons can spawn after Bigger and Badder, have a max hit of 27, teleport around the player, and always land a hit after teleporting if not prayed against.
Teleport anchoring scroll is highly recommended because it prevents Abyssal demons from teleporting the player up to 20 tiles away.
If the player has not read a Teleport anchoring scroll, Auto Retaliate helps resume attacking after being teleported.

Demonbane weaponry works because Abyssal demons are demons: Arclight, Emberlight, Scorching bow, and Demonbane spells receive their relevant bonuses, though AoE magic or Venator bow methods are usually preferred for experience.
Extend Abyssal demon tasks with Augment my abbies because they can provide very high Slayer experience.
Abyssal whip is a 1/512 drop and Abyssal dagger is an extremely rare drop.
Ensouled abyssal heads appear several times per task, making Soul bearer useful; herb sack and Explorer's ring 4 help with herbs and alchables.
Players on Abyssal demon tasks may kill Abyssal Sire instead for profit, accepting significantly lower Slayer experience rates than regular Abyssal demons.
recommendedMethod: Use Catacombs magic for high Slayer experience: tag or goad Abyssal demons, stack them, and cast Smoke Barrage or Smoke Burst with Protect from Melee. Venator bow is a lower-attention ranged alternative. Wilderness Slayer Cave supports cannon plus Accursed sceptre but carries PK risk. Use Emberlight or Arclight for single-combat melee or Slayer Tower tasks.
